newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-SICK PANTANI WINS SECOND STAGE IN THREE DAYS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-SICK PANTANI WINS SECOND STAGE IN THREE DAYS.

text.p: Italian Marco Pantani, who was thinking of pulling out of the Tour de France because of a sore throat, won the 15th stage on Monday.

Pantani, who complained of a sore throat after winning the Alde d'Huez stage on Saturday and again on Sunday, finished one minute 17 seconds ahead of Frenchman Richard Virenque and Jan Ullrich of Germany, second and third respectively.
Ullrich retained the overall leader's yellow jersey and his 6:22 advantage over Virenque after the 208.5-km Alpine stage from Courchevel.
Pantani leapt back into third place after defending champion Bjarne Riis of Denmark, who started the day 24 seconds in front of the Italian, finished 2:06 adrift.
